modules.name: EFG Eightfold Function Generator
modules.description: 8 channel function and envelope generator: rise/fall functions with enveloped oscillations, fired by one gate through index, round, parallel and binary span modes.

modules.name: ETS Eightfold Time Smear
modules.description: Time shift one CV into 8 copies, each read from a shared buffer at its own speed and phase; internal LFO, hold, tempo sync.

modules.name: EGX Eightfold Gesture Extractor
modules.description: Gesture to gates: turns the motion of a CV, or a channel index, into 8 channel gates, odd/even gates and a change pulse; a windowed comparator.
